title: LunarisV Player List Schema (TF2BD v3 extension)

$schema.description: The JSON schema to validate this file against.

steamid.description: The SteamID of the player. SteamID64 (integer) is the primary, preferred form.

steamid3.description: Optional SteamID3 form of the player (e.g. [U:1:123456]). Must resolve to the same account as steamid.

steamid32.description: Optional SteamID2 form of the player (e.g. STEAM_0:1:61728). Must resolve to the same account as steamid.

proof.description: Any associated evidence. Left untouched by the tool (for now).

last_seen.description: Information about the last time this player was seen.

player_name.description: The name this player had the last time they were seen.

time.description: The time this player was last seen.
